title: Great App! Just One Feature Missing for Perfect Workflow
body:
I love using this app for organizing my tasks and notes! It’s user-friendly and keeps everything in one place. However, it would be even better if the reminder feature allowed us to insert a clickable link to a note—similar to how we can add links from one note to another.

This way, when the reminder pops up, we can tap the link and go directly to the relevant note instead of searching manually. This small addition would greatly improve efficiency and workflow. Hope to see this feature in a future update! Keep up the great work! 🚀

title: Clean and easy to use.
body:
If there’s time, then I suggest the users to try and explore all the functions available and try to use them according to needs. For example, I’m a student. So the app is not only a simple reminder for daily task such as groceries or to-dos, but also for my assignments & class activities. Because the app allows uploading of pictures, which makes it easy to review/noted down any crucial info such as rubrics, instructions, messages in the form of screenshots. So it really does make my academic life easier, and of course, a lot more efficient and productive.

I also use it to note down local places (cafes, restaurany) that I wish to visit, and put the map links up there for easier references. And of course, the pictures for the menus and so on.

So I must say that as long as the users are willing to take time & explore explore the app, then I believe it will suit everyone according to their needs. 

If there’s room for improvement, then I suggest to allows other attachment such as documents, and multiple “alert” time slots, as in the calendar app.
